Chapter 303: Selecting A Special Quota

"Later, because the strength of various races became weaker and weaker, and they could no longer obtain the status of a great race in this way, these special quotas were gradually abandoned!"

"Until now, many of you here may not have heard of this special quota for the status of a great race!"

The representative of the human race paused here.

Looking at the expressions of the representatives of the major races present, it turned out that most of them had not heard of the special quota for the status of a great race.

"My idea is that since the five candidate races selected are also recognized by the goblins, these five quotas for the status of a great race should be given to them!"

"And the goblins and the Naga recognize the strength and development potential of the Zerg more. Let's not talk about the development potential first. My human race also recognizes the strength of the Zerg!"

"I guess many of you here are like me. After carefully reading the information of the Zerg, you can see that the strength of the Zerg is no weaker than that of ordinary great races!"

"Since we already have the strength of a great race before obtaining the status of a great race, why don't we give the Zerg a special quota for the status of a great race, and add another member to us through this special method?"

The representative of the human race expressed the idea of the human race.

There is indeed another way for the local camp to obtain the status of a great clan, which is to obtain the authority that a great clan deserves through its own strength.

Whether it is the quota for the status of a great clan or the special quota for the status of a great clan, they are all things generated autonomously by the world rules, and naturally have their reasons for existence.

The goblins also know about the special quota for the status of a great clan. It is very difficult for ordinary races to obtain the status of a great clan through this special quota for the status of a great clan. Ordinary strong races simply cannot do it.

Although the goblins have confidence in the Zerg, the races that obtain the status of a great clan through special quotas are all legendary things. In the history with clear records, no race has ever obtained the status of a great clan in this way.

There are many records of attempts, but they all failed in the end.

The goblins do not want the Zerg to take risks.

The most important point that the human representative did not say is that the races that use the special quota for the status of a great clan will lose the qualification to obtain the status of a great clan using the normal quota for the status of a great clan.

This is like a gamble. Once the bet is lost, they will never have a chance to become a great clan.

Races that are not completely desperate will generally not make this choice.

"Good! This method is good!"

"I didn't expect that I could get the status of a great clan in this way!"

"There are several brother races in my clan who have been waiting for the status of a great clan for too long. If it is feasible, let them try!"

"Throughout the ages, I have never heard of any race succeeding. Are you sure your brother race has this ability?"

"The brother races of my clan are all strong. If they can't do it, I think the Zerg will also be in trouble!"

"It doesn't matter whether it works or not. This is indeed a good way to solve the current problem!"

"..."

Except for the great clans that are friendly with the goblins, the other great clans basically agree with the proposal of the human representatives.

Based on the information they know and the information provided by the goblins, the great clans found that the Zerg is indeed very strong, but the great clans have never dealt with the Zerg, and they don't feel deeply just by listening to others.

Asking everyone to overthrow the five candidate races selected based on the common interests of the great clans for the sake of the Zerg involves too many problems.

Except for the few great clans that firmly support the goblins, the other great clans do not want to make a hasty decision to change the status quo from the bottom of their hearts.

The human race gave a best of both worlds solution. Since the goblins were willing to slap everyone in the face to support the Zerg, let the Zerg rely on their unprecedented strength to fight for the status of a great race.

This is what many representatives of the great races thought.

The representatives of the goblins saw that they were powerless and did not continue to explain. They could only sigh and say, "Then give the Zerg a special quota!"

The new five great races were decided. Except for the goblins and the Naga, everyone was happy.

As for the Zerg, if they are really strong enough, they can rely on the special quota to come up by themselves. If they can't come up, it can only prove that the Zerg is not as strong as the goblins say.

If the Zerg is only a little stronger than the five candidate races, then wait for the next opportunity. With the support of the super great race, the Zerg will have no problem in obtaining the status of a great race, and there is no rush at this time.

The representatives of the goblins understood this truth and no longer fought for it. They used the right of appeal of the super great race, which was already the limit.

As for the fact that the Zerg really chose to use the special quota and lost the status of a great race forever, no one mentioned it.

Some of them knew but didn't mention it, such as the super tribes such as the human race, the goblin race, and the giant race. Some tribes also knew the inside story.

Some tribes really didn't know the inside story and felt at ease.

It is important for people to know themselves, and the same is true for races.

If the Zerg rashly chooses to use the special quota without being sure, it proves that the Zerg is just so-so, and everyone will not feel sorry.

…

The race that has obtained the status of a tribe in the local camp has been determined, but Wu Qing still didn't know anything until Naga wanted to meet him.

Wu Qing thought Naga was here to discuss the cooperation between the two tribes to open up the desert battlefield, but he didn't expect that the main purpose of Naga's visit this time was to tell him about the status of a tribe.

Naga told him the truth about what happened, especially the efforts made by the goblins and the helplessness of the final result.

"That is to say, the Zerg can no longer obtain the status of a great clan this time. They have to wait at least for dozens or hundreds of years for the next opportunity to come?"

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Wu Qing knew that it was not easy for the Zerg to obtain the status of a great clan, but he did not expect to fail directly. In fact, he was prepared in his heart.

The fierce competition for the status of a great clan, which involves world power, can be imagined. The difficulty of success can be imagined if the Zerg intervenes at the last minute.

It was just that the Zerg did not expect that the selection was over before they showed more strength. The time to wait for the next opportunity was too long.

With such a long time to develop, the Zerg did not care about the world power of the great clan at all. The Zerg could fight for the world by developing on their own.

The reason for competing for the world power of the great clan was to develop faster.

"There is no chance to obtain the status of a great clan through normal means this time, but the efforts of our race and the goblins are not in vain!"

"There is also a special quota for obtaining the status of a great clan. The race that needs to obtain the special quota must compete for the fortune of the camp and obtain the status of a great clan!"

"It is very difficult to obtain the status of a great clan in this way, and once you choose to use this special quota, you will lose the qualification to use the normal quota for the status of a great clan!"

"Even if the normal quota for the status of a great clan is given to you, you cannot obtain the status of a great clan!"

"So, you must be cautious when using this special quota!"

"I have some relevant information collected by the goblins and my race, you can take a look!"

Naga took out a piece of information and handed it to Wu Qing.

When Wu Qing heard that there was still a chance, he carefully read the information.

After understanding the cause and effect, Wu Qing has made a decision.

He and the Zerg cannot wait, and now they have to seize the opportunity. Even if it is a little difficult, there is always a way to overcome it.

As for the fact that they could no longer obtain the status of a great clan after failure, it was not important to the Zerg. In a few decades, the world's pattern would be changed by the Zerg, and the status of a great clan would no longer be important.

Another point is that since this world has given two ways to obtain the status of a great clan, one simple and one difficult, the difficult way must have its reasons.

Perhaps, the status of a great clan obtained through difficult means will have unexpected gains.

"We accept the special quota!"

Wu Qing made a decision and informed Naga.

Naga looked at Wu Qing seriously and said nothing more.

With the continuous development of the Zerg, Naga has noticed Wu Qing's extraordinaryness. She was not surprised that Wu Qing could directly take charge of the affairs of the Zerg.

She could feel that Wu Qing accepted the special quota because of his confidence and fearlessness, and she didn't need to say more.

...

After Wu Qing met Naga, he was invited by the goblin tribe to meet Gong Rui, the core elder of the goblin tribe in the main city of the 108th District of the Public Battlefield in the Southern Theater.

The goblins did not invite Wu Qing to the goblin tribe again. As the Zerg showed more strength, Wu Qing's status and position changed, and the attitude of the goblins towards Wu Qing has been changing.

This time, it was Gong Rui who took the initiative to come here to meet Wu Qing.

Regarding the status of the Zerg tribe, Naga said everything that should be said. The goblins and Naga have always kept in touch on this matter, so Gong Rui did not continue to talk about this matter this time.

This time the two met mainly to discuss deepening cooperation between the two tribes.

In addition to the transaction of Zerg energy coins, cooperative research on energy purification related technologies has also been put on the agenda, and some cooperative research related to machinery and biology will also explore cooperative models.

Wu Qing asked the Queen of the Zerg to refine some mechanical technologies from the human technology he knew, combined with the characteristics of the goblins, and took out a few to give to the goblins.

Wu Qing originally studied the human science and technology in a comprehensive and systematic way in the virtual world, and he was also an expert in machinery.

The Goblins did make an effort to help the Zerg gain the status of a powerful tribe, and Wu Qing also accepted this favor.

The result was quite good for Wu Qing, as he won a rare opportunity for the Zerg.

Gong Rui looked at the several technologies presented by Wu Qing on the spot and gained a lot. He was overjoyed and immediately gave Wu Qing a large amount of intelligence information in return.

A lot of information related to this world is common sense for the powerful tribes, but it will not be circulated in the outside world, and it is difficult for a race like the Zerg to obtain it.

The Goblins are making up for the Zerg's shortcomings in this regard, which is also a great favor to the Zerg.

Wu Qing and Gong Rui had a good chat, and the affairs of the two tribes were settled, and it was time for the finale of this meeting.
